    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if max(Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).values()) >= 0.7 * h]

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    candidates = []
    for color in colors:
        rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(color) >= 0.65 * w]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) >= 0.65 * h]
        if len(rows) >= 2 and len(cols) >= 2:
            deviations = sum(grid[r][c] != color for r in rows for c in cols)
            candidates.append((deviations, color, rows, cols))
    _, line_color, row_lines, col_lines = max(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])
    intersections = [[grid[r][c] for c in col_lines] for r in row_lines]
    marked = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(intersections) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v != line_color]
    r0, r1 = min(i for i, _ in marked), max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(j for _, j in marked), max(j for _, j in marked)
    line_set_r, line_set_c = set(row_lines), set(col_lines)
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in line_set_r and c not in line_set_c]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = (intersections[i][j], intersections[i][j+1], intersections[i+1][j], intersections[i+1][j+1])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != line_color and len(set(corners)) == 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
